text: Thank you! Everything in me says "Thank you!" Angels listen as I sing my thanks.
and say it again: "Thank you!" Thank you for your love, thank you for your faithfulness; Most holy is your name, most holy is your Word.
you made my life large with strength.
all earth's kings will say "Thank you."
no matter the distance, he knows everything about us.
keep me alive in the angry turmoil. With one hand strike my foes, With your other hand save me.
Your love is eternal—don't quit on me now.
